Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 12, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - The Reverend Michael Carr, All Saints Episcopal Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamations to Outgoing Miss Pride of Vista and Miss Teen Tri-City and Introduction of the Incoming Courts
P2.
Presentation by Representatives of the 2011 San Diego County Fair
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending February 28, 2011 (CC)
C4.
All-Way Stop on Shadowridge Drive at Longhorn Drive (CC)
C5.
Preliminary Engineering Design Services (CC)
C6.
FY 2011/12 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , in accordance with City Council Ordinance No. 2006-6; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2011- , in accordance with BSD Board Ordinance No. 2006-2.
C7.
Wave Waterpark Solar Project - Rejection of Bids for CIP No. 8217 (CC)
C8.
Special Event Banner and Signs (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Right-of-Way Permit Fees (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving changes to the permit fees for work in the public right-of-way.
PH2.
Application for FTA Section 5310 Grants Funds from the California Department of Transportation (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, in regard to whether there is a local nonprofit service (recommended action continued on following page) (recommended action continued from previous page) provider that is readily available to provide services
in lieu of the Out and About Vista Senior Transportation Program, close the public hearing, and
2.
In the absence of such a provider, direct the City Manager to sign the "Public Agency Certification of No Readily Available Service Providers" and submit the document to the California Department of Transportation as part of the funding application; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the submission of an application for FTA Section 5310 grant funds from the California Department of Transportation, and authorize the City Manager to sign the application on behalf of the City.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
